source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Set individualized development goals with specific actions and a realistic review timeline","B":"Use identical development goals for every nurse regardless of experience or career interest","C":"Limit professional development plans to disciplinary deficiencies rather than career growth","D":"Avoid specific goals because professional development should occur without formal planning"}}
source_row.rationale: An individualized professional development plan typically includes specific, personalized goals related to skill development, further education, certification, or career advancement, along with a realistic plan and timeline for achieving them, supporting the nurse's ongoing professional growth aligned with their interests and organizational needs.
source_row.source_detail: Professional development planning includes individualized learning/career goals and planned activities; accessed 2026-08-14.
source_row.source_name: American Nurses Association — Professional Development Resources
